study_identification_part.si_4_title: Multivariate brain- cognition associations in euthymic bipolar disorder

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Normative model uses HCP Young Adult, OpenBHB, OASIS-3, Cam-CAN, and a Newcastle University single-site cohort (NCL); BLISS provides the BD/HC study cohort.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We utilised four public datasets of T1-weighted scans from healthy controls: - the WU-Minn Human Connectome Project Young Adult (HCP; ...); - Open Big Healthy Brains (OpenBHB; ...); - Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (OASIS-3; ...); and - the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (Cam-CAN; ...)." "We also used a cohort of healthy adult participants scanned at Newcastle University as part of another study (site=NCL)." "Data were collected as part of the Bipolar Lithium Imaging and Spectroscopy Study (BLISS)."
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.location: bdi13484-sup-0001-supinfo.docx.md: 1 Normative model of cortical thickness, paragraphs 1-2; Little2024.pdf.md: Methods / Participants

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative model healthy control dataset (Newcastle University NCL cohort)

answer.BLISS: clinical study cohort: BD patients and matched HCs; BLISS HCs used for site offset/harmonization

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Public datasets and the NCL cohort form the normative-HC reference sample; BLISS provides the BD/HC sample and BLISS HCs are included in the harmonized normative data for site correction.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "We utilised four public datasets of T1-weighted scans from healthy controls: ..." "We also used a cohort of healthy adult participants scanned at Newcastle University as part of another study (site=NCL)." "To mitigate issues with a small healthy control sample, we developed normative models of cortical thickness using large public normative datasets. ... We harmonised the normative-HC data, including the 26 HCs recruited to BLISS, for each ROI by regressing age, sex and scanning protocol (i.e., site; as a random effect) on cortical thickness..." "Euthymic BD patients ( n = 56)  and  matched  healthy  controls  ( n = 26)  underwent T1-weighted MRI scans..."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative-HC sample size reported as n=6344; outliers removed n=393 (final N not explicitly stated).
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "A sample of n = 6344 healthy individuals were included (normative-HC: mean age 32.64; 50.3% females; see Data S1 for further details)." "We removed controls who had outliers in any ROI, defined as residuals greater than 5 median absolute deviations ( n = 393)."
